EC1: Patients with symptomatic CNS metastases [OR] or leptomeningeal involvement
EC2: Patients with known brain metastases [AND], [NOT] unless these metastases have been treated [OR] and/or have been stable for at least six months prior to study start. Subjects with a history of [AND] brain metastases [AND] must have a head CT with contrast to document either response or progression.
EC3: Patients with bone metastases [AND] as the only site(s) of measurable disease
EC4: Patients with hepatic artery chemoembolization within the last 6 months [OR] (one month if there are other sites of measurable disease)
EC5: Patients who have been previously treated with radioactive directed therapies
EC6: Patients who have been previously treated with epothilone
EC7: Patients with any peripheral neuropathy [OR] or unresolved diarrhea [AND] greater than Grade 1
EC8: Patients with severe cardiac insufficiency [AND] patients taking Coumadin [OR] or other warfarin-containing agents [AND] [NOT] with the exception of low dose [OR] warfarin (1 mg or less) [AND] for the maintenance of in-dwelling lines [OR] or ports
EC9: Patients taking any experimental therapies history of another malignancy within 5 years prior to study entry [NOT] except curatively treated non-melanoma skin cancer [OR], prostate cancer [OR], or cervical cancer in situ
EC10: Patients with active [OR] or suspected acute [OR] or chronic uncontrolled infection including abcesses [OR] or fistulae
EC11: Patients with a medical [OR] or psychiatric illness that would preclude study [OR] or informed consent [OR] and/or history of noncompliance to medical regimens [OR] or inability [OR] or unwillingness to return for all scheduled visits
